Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter

package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter
Servlet filters that augment Juneau REST server request handling.

Includes RequestIdFilter, which assigns a unique request ID to each incoming request for correlation in logs and responses, and RequestBoundaryFilter, which applies a RequestBoundary to every request and rejects those that did not originate from a page the application served.

LoopbackBoundary is the boundary for a loopback-bound application, and LoopbackBoundaryFilter applies it. Every boundary reports its decision as a BoundaryResult carrying a BoundaryReason.

CsrfBoundary is the boundary for an application reachable from other hosts: it checks the request's origin against the application's own and, on a write, a CSRF token issued by CsrfTokens, either bound to the session or shared by the process. Applied through RequestBoundaryFilter, an allowed request carries the token for its page both as a single value and as a supplier of freshly masked values, one per embed; and a safe page load gets a session when the token is bound to one, so the page it is served carries a token that verifies.
